enables: This same template plugs any SDTM study's demographics (DM) and labs (LB) domains into mdrlens.uln's peak-x-ULN method -- the identical arithmetic §04's eDISH view uses on the primary study. Demonstrated on pharmaversesdtm's separately packaged metabolic-panel dataset (5 CDISC pilot subjects with their own LB domain): its labs and liver-panel view, by the same peak-x-ULN method §04's eDISH view uses.
